answer: Your records list no allergies. Nothing is recorded for drugs, foods or anything else. That is not the same as a confirmed 'no known allergies'. It means none has been entered. The records can't tell me whether you have an allergy that was never written down, so if you've had a reaction to a medicine, food or latex, tell your doctor so it can be added. Also, your records don't show any reaction to the medicines you take now (atorvastatin and Jardiance).
